summary: Learn to map data flows, assess platform privacy controls and build release evidence. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Privacy engineering for AI and enterprise analytics translates privacy requirements into practical controls across data flows, model workflows, and analytics releases. This intermediate course is for privacy engineers, data platform teams, and AI practitioners who need to review platform changes. You’ll practise mapping data lineage and purpose, assessing model-workflow risks, and documenting access, retention, release checks, and evidence for design decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who shape, operate or review privacy controls in AI and enterprise analytics environments.
modules: NIST Privacy Framework for Platform Design
NIST AI RMF for Model Workflows
